strategies.name: first_candle_fvg_retest_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the high/low of the first 9:30-9:35 candle, then switch to the 1-minute chart and wait for price to break the level with a fair value gap. After price retests into that FVG, enter on engulfing confirmation.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop under the lowest area traded into the FVG with one tick of breathing room, and take profit at a fixed 3:1 reward-to-risk target. No micromanagement after entry.

strategies.name: first_candle_fvg_limit_entry_day_trade
strategies.entry_summary: On the 15-minute chart, mark the high/low of the first 9:30-9:45 candle, then switch to the 5-minute chart and wait for a fair value gap. Instead of waiting for a retest/engulfing confirmation, place a passive limit order directly on the FVG so the trade enters when price trades back into it.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop at the first candle in the FVG pattern, just under that candle, and target a fixed 2:1 reward-to-risk. The speaker says to hold through revisits of the FVG and not to micromanage the trade.

result.enumeration_note: Two distinct strategies are taught: a scalp entry using FVG retest + engulfing confirmation, and a day-trade entry using a passive limit on the FVG. They share the FVG skeleton but differ in entry logic and exit target, so they are separate objects.
